map.NIHSS（美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表）是评估急性脑卒中神经功能缺损严重程度的金: The NIHSS (National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale) is the gold standard for assessing acute stroke neurological deficit severity, with 15 items, total 0-42, higher = worse deficit.
map.NIHSS 卒中量表总分 = 15 个神经功能项目之和，满分 42；0 无卒中症: NIHSS total = sum of 15 neurological items, max 42; 0 no stroke symptoms, <=1 minimal, <=4 mild, <=15 moderate, <=20 mod-severe, >20 severe; higher = worse deficit.
map.NIHSS评分需由经过培训的评估者执行，尽早评估: NIHSS should be performed by trained raters, as early as possible
map.评分以首次反应为准，不重复指导: Score by first response, no repeated instruction
map.NIHSS是溶栓治疗决策的重要参考: NIHSS is an important reference for thrombolysis decisions
map.13 项合计 9 分 /42：中度缺损（5~15），需评估溶栓/取栓。: 13 items total 9 /42: moderate deficit (5-15), assess thrombolysis/thrombectomy.
map.合计 25 /42：重度，预后较差，加强监护。: Total 25 /42: severe, poorer prognosis, intensify monitoring.
map.同一 NIHSS 量表的实现，评分标准一致。: Implementation of the same NIHSS scale, identical scoring criteria.
map.NIHSS是国际通用的脑卒中神经功能缺损评估量表，包含意识、凝视、视野、面瘫、运: NIHSS is an internationally used stroke neurological deficit scale, with 15 items (consciousness, gaze, vision, facial palsy, motor, ataxia, sensation, language, dysarthria, neglect), total 0-42, widely used for acute stroke severity, thrombolysis decisions and prognosis.
